name: Kentucky

agency.name: Kentucky Energy and Environment Cabinet
agency.division: Department for Environmental Protection, Division for Air Quality (DAQ)

localAgencies.name: Louisville Metro Air Pollution Control District
localAgencies.notes: Handles air permitting in Jefferson County; DAQ covers all other counties.

overview: Kentucky DAQ requires registration or permit approval before construction begins. Very small sources may need nothing; others register (401 KAR 52:070), get a minor/state-origin permit (52:040), a conditional major/FESOP (52:030), or a Title V permit (52:020). PSD applies to certain major projects in attainment areas.

permitTypes.name: Insignificant and trivial activities
permitTypes.description: Insignificant activities must be listed in applications and permits; trivial activities need not be included.

permitTypes.name: Registration
permitTypes.description: Some sources above certain thresholds must register rather than obtain a permit.

permitTypes.name: Minor / State-Origin Permit
permitTypes.description: For sources above registration levels and below major thresholds.
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DAQ: above registration levels but below 100 TPY of a non-hazardous pollutant, and below 10 TPY of any single HAP or 25 TPY of all HAPs.

permitTypes.name: Conditional Major (FESOP)
permitTypes.description: For sources whose potential emissions would otherwise require a major permit, if they accept limits.

permitTypes.name: PSD
permitTypes.description: Applies to certain major projects in areas meeting air quality standards; requires BACT.

permitTypes.name: Major / Title V Permit
permitTypes.thresholds: Per DAQ: more than 100 TPY of any non-hazardous pollutant, or more than 10 TPY of any single HAP or 25 TPY of all HAPs combined.

oilAndGas.summary: DAQ's permitting page lists no oil-and-gas-specific air permit. Oil and gas facilities follow the registration/state-origin/conditional major/Title V framework; federal NSPS OOOO-series and NESHAP HH apply where applicable.
